nom: belif Aqua Bomb Depuffing Eye Gel with Caffeine + Hyaluronic Acid

segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers consistently report no irritation or breakouts, describing the fragrance-free, water-based gel as gentle while still reducing puffiness and darkness.
segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin report the gel hydrates without adding oiliness or triggering the breakouts they get from most other eye moisturizers.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry under-eye skin, including one dealing with dryness from retinoid use, report the gel visibly plumps and brightens the area, in one case within minutes of a single application.
segments.combination: One reviewer with combination skin and early fine lines found the gel pleasant and cooling but saw no real change in puffiness, dark circles, or texture after two months.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 40s and 60s report visible softening of fine lines and under-eye puffiness, including one who saw a deep line and a drooping eyelid improve.

concerns.aging: Many reviewers report the gel visibly softens fine lines and adds plumpness to the under-eye area, sometimes within minutes, with results some describe as dramatic even on deeper lines and one reporting improvement in a forehead wrinkle. A number of reviewers, including one with combination skin and early fine lines, report no visible change in lines, puffiness, or texture even after weeks to two months of use.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers describe the gel as noticeably hydrating and plumping, with several noting it absorbs quickly without a greasy or sticky feel. A few report it delivers only light moisture, not enough to use alone at night, and recommend a heavier cream for evening.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers warn the gel burns badly if it gets directly into the eye, with one reporting burning that lasted about 40 minutes, so it needs careful application near the lash line. Reviewers who apply it correctly on the skin report no irritation, redness, or itchiness, including some who specifically describe their skin as sensitive.
concerns.blemishes: A couple of reviewers, including one with oily skin whose other eye moisturizers usually trigger breakouts, report this gel absorbs well and causes no breakouts or irritation.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily skin report the gel hydrates the under-eye area without adding shine or a greasy feel on top of their existing oiliness.
concerns.spots: One reviewer credits the vitamin C in the formula with visibly fading hyperpigmentation under her eyes within days.

aspects.libelle: Cooling ceramic applicator tip is a highlight
Requires heavy pump pressure, can hurt or jam
Lightweight gel absorbs fast, layers well under makeup
Applicator tip can crack or snap if dropped
Small tube empties faster than expected for the price

extraits.titre: No results- caffeine led to eye twitching
extraits.texte: I've used this product consistently for 3 weeks, and I saw no results. I have under-eye patches that after 1 application reduce puffiness and dark circles, so I know it's possible- but this product is not it. Also, I developed significant eye-twitching in both eyes from the caffeine in the product. This had been reducing since I stopped using it 2 weeks ago, but they're not totally gone yet.

I got a free sample of this in an Ulta gift with purchase and used the entire thing over the course if two months. I saw absolutely no difference in puffiness, dark circles, or texture. The only reason I didn't give it 1 star is that it is pleasant to apply and feels cooling. I guess it could work as an overpriced gel moisturizer for the eye area, but only if you need a light moisture. This does not deliver a lot of moisture. I liked it for day time but use something much thicker for night time. I have combo skin and am 42 with some fine lines, for what it's worth. I would never pay more than say $5-10 for this product.

Belif sent me this free sample of Aqua Bomb Eye Gel through the BzzAgent sampling program. I used the product for about a week as directed twice a day (morning and evening). It took about 3 days for me to see a difference in my undereyes - but i did see a difference. The dark circles faded, the plumpness returned to the area and the skin looked brighter overall. The formula is great for sensitive skin, no fragrance and water based so absorbs quickly and doesn't leave a sticky residue. My only complaint is that it took longer than i expected to see results but once i saw them the wait was worth it. I will for sure be buying this product again!

I'm 31 (fine lines and dark circles), and currently struggling with super dry skin around my eyes from rets. I had a tester of this and decided to try it out. I walked out of my bathroom after application, and when I walked back in a few mins later I was SHOCKED at how bright and plump my undereyes looked! I've never used an eye cream that gave an instant result like this one- I immediately ordered the full size.
it's honestly such a great product, supper moisturizing. I have oily skin and most moistures cause breakouts because my skin doesn't absorb them! this eyes hydrates me and melts into my face
I really enjoyed the aqua bomb eye gel. I am always looking for good moisturizing products as I get older. This was very hydrating. I have sensitive skin and this did not irritate my skin at all.

extraits.titre: This eye gel is ABSOLUTELY AMAZING!!!!
extraits.texte: I have become very leary of eye creams! I've spent hundreds of dollars in the past on products that didn't measure up to their claims. When I received this free product to test I was skeptical, to say the least! I am SO HAPPY to say that BELIF AQUA BOMB EYE GEL is AMAZING!!! I truly was hooked from my first use and the results are unbelievable! Other products have proven time again to be heavy and they never layered well with makeup. This product is an ultra-lightweight, anti-aging treatment, that reduces puffiness right away. My concealer layers perfectly due to the smooth canvas that my under eye area transforms into. I LOVE that it has Vitamin C in it, which has been visibly targeting my hyperpigmentation under my eyes and making my eyes brighter in just days! I would recommend this product to ANYONE and I even have my husband using it now. I am so grateful for the opportunity to test this product for free. I can't compliment it enough! I would shout from the rooftops that I will buy again and again and again!!
